question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3. **
solution:
The correct answer is: "**around**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Around**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 3.
 
• "**Around**" means to encircle or surround something. (किसी चीज़ को घेरना)
 
• In this context, it refers to something moving in a circular motion.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Revolving **means to move in a circular or orbiting path. (परिक्रामी)
 
• **Surmounting **means to overcome or conquer a difficulty or obstacle. (विजय पाना)
 
• **Rotating **means to spin or turn around an axis. (घूर्णन)
